aircraft: Generic FG 737 NG class (verified paths: FG core; aircraft-specific paths marked)
notes: Single source of truth for FlightGear property paths (spec §5). Paths under /instrumentation and MCP/autobrake sections are AIRCRAFT-MODEL-DEPENDENT: verify against the installed 737 package (e.g. 737-800YV) with scripts/fg-diagnostic before relying on them. scale converts FG-native units to the schema's explicit units.

sim.simTimeSec.comment: FG core simulation clock. Required so pause/freeze never advances training time through a wall-clock fallback. SOURCE_REQUIRED: confirm with fg-diagnostic on the installed build.

mcp.autopilotEngaged.comment: AIRCRAFT-MODEL-DEPENDENT: many 737 models expose a dedicated CMD A property instead — verify

nav.locDeviationDots.comment: FG deflection is ±10 full scale; ±2.5 dots -> scale 0.25. Verify per aircraft.

nav.gsDeviationDots.comment: FG deflection is ±3.5 full scale; ±2.5 dots -> scale 5/7. Verify per aircraft.

mcp.approachArmed.comment: AIRCRAFT-MODEL-DEPENDENT: APP armed annunciation. SOURCE_REQUIRED — verify with fg-diagnostic; absent means the state reports false.

weather.windDirDeg.comment: FG core environment; optional so the state degrades to 0 when absent.

set_control_axis.pitch.comment: Schema +1 = nose up; FG elevator -1 = nose up

set_flaps.comment: value is normalized 0..1 (detent -> norm in adapter)

set_reverse_thrust.comment: AIRCRAFT-MODEL-DEPENDENT: some models use boolean reverser + throttle

set_autopilot.comment: AIRCRAFT-MODEL-DEPENDENT: verify CMD A property for the chosen 737 package

set_toga.comment: AIRCRAFT-MODEL-DEPENDENT: TO/GA. SOURCE_REQUIRED — many 737 packages expose this as a button property instead.
